summary: This video showcases an Ice Blast team strategy against Elecebre in the Continental Challenge, reaching over 499 million total damage for an S rank. The team consists of Fredegonda, Beldelle, Shinnah, Ernesto, and Felosia. The strategy relies on fine-tuned ultimate timing to cast skills right before Elecebre acts, preventing her turn meter reduction mechanic.

heroes.name: Fredegonda
heroes.note: Build full crit rate and crit damage to share stats with the team.

heroes.name: Shinnah
heroes.note: Build with accuracy and Witches set.

heroes.name: Ernesto
heroes.note: Build with as much attack as possible.

teams.note: Time all ultimates to cast immediately before Elecebre uses her ultimate to prevent turn meter reduction.

tips: Ensure all team members have sufficient defensive stats to survive the entire fight duration.
